title: Cost Sprint Portfolio: Priority Matrix for Batching/Caching/Quantization Field Trials
creator: Emily Nakamura
description: Establish a reproducible priority matrix and execution playbook to select, run, and evaluate 6-week field trials across batching, KV prefix caching, and quantization options. The goal is to produce a ranked portfolio of interventions with expected per-token savings, latency impact envelope, rollout risk, and engineering effort so PM and Eng can commit to Quarterly OKRs with quantified ROI.
acceptance_criteria: Priority matrix populated for at least 12 candidate interventions with scoring for savings, latency risk, implementation effort, and customer impact
Three field trials (one per tech knob: batching, cache, quant) defined with test harness, success metrics, and runbook
Evaluation dashboard seeded with baseline vs trial throughput, P50/P95 latency, token-econ, and quality regression signals
Playbook published with clear gating rules for canary -> gradual rollout -> auto-fallback
metrics: Observed delta tokens/sec and GPU utilization
comments: 2025-02-12 - Kickoff: PM, Eng leads, and Research sync. Agreed on 4 scoring axes: savings, latency risk, dev effort, customer exposure. Action: PM to assemble candidate list.
2025-02-19 - Candidate list (14 items) uploaded. Eng triage performed; removed 2 low-feasibility items. Added prefixed-KV lifecycle as separate candidate.
2025-02-25 - Research: baseline microbench harness finished. Measured baseline P50 42ms on sequence=256 test cluster. Drafts of experiment guardrails circulated.
2025-03-07 - Design review: Console UX for trial toggles & per-route rollout controls prototype accepted by Console PM. Linking rollout flags to lower-level autoscale policies required.
2025-03-14 - Eng update: batching prototype (micro-batcher v2) shows 12% token-econ improvement with +6ms P50. Quality check on canonical prompt-set shows no regressions. Preparing canary PR.

2025-03-28 - PM note: Priority matrix scoring complete. Top 3 items chosen for field trials: adaptive batching, prefix-KV TTL strategy, 4-bit post-training quant profile. Next: schedule stakeholder sync and set OKR targets.
blockers: Autoscale integration gap between trial toggles and Dedicated pools (blocks canary on some customers)
Quantization validation harness for end-to-end quality checks still under development
